content: पराजि €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> ²1 To defeat, conquer, overcome, subdue; यं पराजयसे मृषा <ls>Y. 2. 75</ls>; <ls>Bk. 8. 9</ls>; <ls>Śi. 19. 82</ls>. .²2 To lose, be deprived of. .²3 To be conquered or overcome by, find (something) unbearable; अध्ययनात् पराजयते <ls>Sk.</ls> ‘finds it unbearable or difficult to study’; तां पराजयमानां स प्रीते रक्ष्यां दशाननात् <ls>Bk. 8. 71</ls>. .²4 To submit or yield to.
